decisions.decision: Recommend Scalar Quantization (int8) as the primary default due to minimal accuracy loss and strong AVX2 SIMD support. Use Binary Quantization with rescoring for extreme latency requirements if the model is compatible.
decisions.context: Quantization choice for 768-dim vectors on Zen 2
